notes: Mixed-basis report: governmental funds modified cash basis (FY ending 9/30/2023), proprietary funds (Light, Water, Sewer) accrual basis (FY ending 4/30/2023). Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds 2023 column (p6). Intergovernmental revenues 1,273,496 split by the printed fund-schedule rows (General p11, Street p14, Bond p34); Charges for services/reimbursements 1,093,736 split by fund column (Landfill, Street, Parks, Pool, Library, Community Building; nonmajor columns also on Sch 9 p20-21) which ties exactly. Debt service 876,723 split from the Bond fund schedule (p34). Landfill Fund interest 5,113 and principal 32,316 are printed under Other financing sources (uses): top-level other_financing -37,429; detail lines in section other financing. Roll-forward ties on fund balance: 8,169,032 + 6,365,205 - 5,468,312 + 1,685,963 - 1,603,928 - 37,429 = 9,110,531. Cash and fund balance are separate: ending_cash = cash and cash equivalents + cash with county treasurer (p4), certificates of deposit in *_investments; cash does not roll forward on its own because fund balance also includes special assessments receivable (101,480 vs 38,093) net of warrants payable 3,000. Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Net Position (p8), net position measure; operating 'Miscellaneous' counted in Charges for Services on p2; disbursement total 10,060,003 printed on p2. Proprietary cash flows from Totals 2023 column (p10). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1; governmental funds statement totals 9,113,531 do not equal the government-wide 18,320,194, which includes capital assets and debt), zero cells omitted. Detail: per-fund budget schedules (Sch 1-5, 10-17, 19, 21); zero-actual lines kept only where a budget figure is printed (all-zero lines skipped); Schedule 22 combined budget comparison (p36, fund totals incl. transfers, plus fiduciary Trust and Agency) not recorded to avoid double counting. Nonmajor combining schedules (Sch 7 p17, Sch 8 pp18-19, Sch 9 pp20-21) are summaries of the individual nonmajor fund schedules (Sch 10-21) already recorded, so not recorded again. Business-type detail from Schedule 23 (p37, combined Light/Water/Sewer proprietary funds, Actual accrual column = statement basis; Budget column as budget_final; budget-only expense rows printed in parentheses stored positive).
